# Qbamart
> Qbamart is a premium e-commerce platform built with a Django REST Framework backend and a React/Vite frontend.

Qbamart offers a seamless shopping experience tailored for the Bangladeshi market, featuring secure OTP authentication, robust product and order management, dynamic SEO generation, and an intuitive admin dashboard. 

## Documentation
- [SEO Setup](https://qbamart.com/SEO.md): Details about SEO routes and metadata implementation.

## Project Structure
- [Frontend (React)](https://qbamart.com): Modern Single Page Application (SPA) providing a fast, responsive user interface.
- [Backend (Django API)](https://api.qbamart.com): Scalable backend API handling users, products, orders, and payment integrations.
